three only because they have the highest conventionScore, or three extensions of the same substitution.

modelApproximations identifies input chords simplified ONLY for the learned model's fixed vocabulary.
For these chords, use the original symbol and exact mathematical tones when comparing substitutions;
the learned score cannot distinguish every extension or alteration. Never treat a projection as an edit.
Do not answer in prose. Finish with offer_candidates after at least two different searches.

function.name: search_substitutions
function.description: Compare one to three families together: enumerate sparse substitutions, prune mathematically, and score each shortlist with the trained Music Transformer against preceding and following bars. Start with at least two different families in one call.

function.name: offer_candidates
function.description: Finish with three distinct candidate IDs already returned by the search tool. Offer contrasting options for the composer, without applying or rewriting any chords.
